name: Steel Exchange India Limited
summary: Steel Exchange India Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of steel products under the SIMHADRI TMT brand name in India. It operates through Iron and Steel, and Power segments. The company offers rebars; billets and ingots; sponge iron and pig iron; steel scrap; iron ore; and pillets. It also deals in a range of steel products, including semis, coal, scrap, and others. In addition, the company generates and sell power from waste heat recovery boilers. Steel Exchange India Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Visakhapatnam, India.
